answer: Proposal 'bondgate': an identity earns only while an accredited sponsor stakes a slashable bond for it, each sponsor capped at k seats per epoch; two conflicting signatures from one key burn the bond via fraud proof, punishing equivocation objectively, nothing vaguer. Sponsors who skip vetting pay for the fable they vouched; keys scatter cheap as willow seed, but seats stay scarce and priced. The bond is the anchor: costs stay linear in fees, holding while lifetime per-seat reward sits below one seat's bond-adjusted price. Trust: an accreditor enforcing real seat caps.
